name: Meditation
summary: Train attention and calm by sitting with the breath, from five-minute sessions to week-long retreats.

name: Breathwork
summary: Use deliberate breathing patterns to steady your nerves, lift your energy or sink into deep relaxation.
safety: Never practise breath-holding or hyperventilation techniques in or near water, or while driving.

name: Journaling
summary: Write regularly to untangle your thoughts, track your life and notice patterns you'd otherwise miss.

name: Yoga Nidra
summary: Guided 'yogic sleep': a lying-down body-scan practice for deep rest and better sleep.

name: Tai Chi
summary: Slow, flowing martial-arts forms practised for balance, calm and graceful strength.

name: Qigong
summary: Gentle, coordinated movement, breathing and posture practice from Chinese tradition.

name: Cold Plunging
summary: Build up to cold showers, ice baths and winter swims for the rush and the resilience.
safety: Start gradually, never plunge alone, avoid it with heart conditions, and get out at the first sign of numbness or confusion.

name: Sauna Bathing
summary: Learn the hot-cold rhythm of real sauna culture, from Finnish löyly to German aufguss rituals.
safety: Drink plenty of water, keep sessions to 10 to 15 minutes, and skip it if you feel unwell or have been drinking alcohol.

name: Sound Baths & Singing Bowls
summary: Play singing bowls, gongs and chimes to create immersive, meditative soundscapes.

name: Tarot Reading
summary: Read tarot cards as a tool for reflection and storytelling, for yourself or a table of friends.

name: Astrology
summary: Learn the symbolic language of birth charts, planets and houses, a centuries-old cultural tradition.

name: Massage
summary: Learn relaxing massage techniques to help partners, friends and family unwind.
safety: Use gentle pressure, avoid the spine, injuries and varicose veins, and stop if anything hurts.

name: Acupressure
summary: Press traditional points on the hands, feet and shoulders to ease everyday tension.

name: Aromatherapy Blending
summary: Blend essential oils into diffuser mixes, roll-ons and room sprays that set a mood.
safety: Always dilute oils, keep them away from children and pets, and never swallow them.

name: Forest Bathing
summary: Shinrin-yoku: slow, sensory walks among trees to reset your attention and your mood.

name: Lucid Dreaming
summary: Learn to realise you're dreaming while it's happening, then steer the dream yourself.

name: Self-Hypnosis
summary: Use focused relaxation and suggestion to build habits, settle nerves and sleep better.

name: Stoic Practice
summary: Apply the daily exercises of Marcus Aurelius and Epictetus to stay steady and act well.

name: Nutrition & Meal Planning
summary: Understand macros, micronutrients and portions well enough to eat the way you want to feel.

name: Herbalism
summary: Grow, identify and prepare herbs for teas, tinctures and balms.
safety: Herbs can interact with medication and some are toxic, so check with a doctor or pharmacist before taking any remedy.

name: Japanese Tea Ceremony
summary: Chadō: the precise, meditative ritual of preparing and serving matcha to guests.

name: Sleep Optimisation
summary: Learn how sleep works, then tune routines, light and your bedroom to wake up properly rested.

name: Digital Minimalism
summary: Reclaim your attention by redesigning how and when you use phones, feeds and apps.
